summary: Make the before/after comparison slider in site/index.html keyboard accessible by: adding tabindex="0", role="slider", aria-label, aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, and aria-valuenow to the #cmp element; handling ArrowLeft/ArrowRight (±5 points), Home (0), and End (100) keyboard events that also cancel the sweep animation; updating aria-valuenow whenever setSplit is called; giving the before/after images descriptive alt text (mode + prompt) that updates on example change while keeping the bg-blur image decorative (alt=""); and adding a visible :focus-visible outline to .cmp in style.css.
acceptance_criteria: The slider is keyboard focusable with a slider role, accessible label, min/max 0/100, and accurate current value.
ArrowLeft/ArrowRight adjust the split by 5 points within 0..100; Home/End select 0/100.
Keyboard interaction stops automatic sweep animation and has visible focus styling.
Before/after descriptions include the selected example mode and prompt and update on selection; background stays decorative.
Pointer dragging and example selection still work, and reduced-motion/manual/normal video playback behavior is preserved.
